experiments.question: Can sub-millisecond sequential latest reads still mix independently changing state/graph/activation/projection versions?

setup.model: independent Poisson updates; a mixed capture occurs if a source changes after t0 but before its read
setup.scope: constructed stress sanity check; not FRANK rate estimate

experiments.interpretation: Low read span does not guarantee one logical epoch. Immutable pinned versions can make one request observe a consistent prior epoch while updates continue; latest+validate instead incurs workload-dependent retries.
